title: Describe a hosted read failure
responsibility: Turns a failed hosted response into a bounded public error without repeating arbitrary server prose.

inputs.name: hostedPublicFailure.response
inputs.description: The HTTP response to inspect. At most 4,096 body bytes are read as JSON to look for a recognized public error code.

outputs.name: hostedPublicFailure
outputs.description: A promise for a HostedFailureValidator error object, marked denied for status 401 or 403 and failed otherwise. A recognized code is included in the message; malformed, oversized or unrecognized bodies fall back to the HTTP status. The error object is returned, not thrown here.
